info.description: One time a session runs, with the moment it starts and the moment it ends. A session running on three days has three.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Starts
edit.description: The day and the time this instance begins. An all-day session still carries both — the website hides the time rather than the session losing it.

edit.label: Ends
edit.description: The day and the time this instance finishes.
